name: Large-Scale Unit Commitment MILP Benchmark Dataset
description: # Five Large-Scale Unit Commitment MILP Instances This dataset contains five deterministic mixed-integer linear programming instances for thermal generation and pumped-storage hydropower scheduling. Each model covers 96 scheduling periods of 15 minutes, representing a 24-hour horizon. The instances retain the original identifiers Physics 1 through Physics 5. They range from 100 to 1,508 thermal units and 15 to 150 pumped-storage units, with 145,456–2,061,959 constraint rows, 66,240–955,008 variables and 31,680–463,104 binary variables. The models include commitment, startup/shutdown, minimum up/down times, ramping, piecewise-linear costs, storage operating modes and energy balance, power balance, upward reserve and network interface flow limits. Explicit N-1 contingency constraints are not included. Five gzip-compressed MPS files preserve the original models without presolve or reductions. Supplementary JSON metadata provides unit/time variable mappings, selected temporal parameters, original identifiers and checksums. An independent Python script verifies model integrity, dimensions and metadata using only the standard library. The MPS files define the mathematical optimization problems. The additional UC metadata provides interpretation without modifying the constraints. Modeling limitations and missing metadata are documented in the README. Original data-provider attribution and redistribution terms have not been established from the supplied materials.
